name: Sanjoy Roy
headline: Director, Oracle NetSuite CPM & Analytics Solutions - GTM JAPAC
about:
Financial Performance Management and Analytics solution evangelist and product strategist, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end solutions, across the globe, across different businesses and cultures. 
A technologist with an in-depth knowledge of Finance helping businesses to unlock the value of NetSuite CPM and Analytics solution - which includes Reporting, Analytics, FP&A and Data Warehousing solutions and improve their processes using Oracle Machine learning and deep learning.
Responsible for strategizing, developing & growing Oracle NetSuite CPM and Analytics business & solutions throughout Asia-Pacific with primary focus on the Australia/NZ and the greater Asian market including Greater China and Japan.
Speaker and presenter of NetSuite CPM, Analytics and AI solutions at various webinars and events including SuiteConnect and Oracle Open World.

Passionate about working with businesses closely and delivering a great user experience.
Passionate about mentoring people and building teams, so as the belief that this is where building anything noteworthy, starts. The belief that the software will be as good as the people who had built them.

Expertise: 
Corporate Finance, Statistical Methods in Finance, Quantitative Modelling, Investment and Portfolio Management, Risk, Financial Planning/Reporting/Consolidation/Analytics, Customer 360, Operational Research, Strategy, BPM.

Interests: Fascinated and well as intrigued with the paradigm shift in Business Strategies and Customer 360 in particular, evolving through the pandemic, along with the technology innovations (GenAI, Blockchain, Quantum Computing and Web 3.0 in particular) ushering us into Industry 4.0 / 4IR

experiences.position: Principal Solution Advisor, Oracle NetSuite CPM - GTM JAPAC
experiences.description:
Back to where I belong. Embarked on an exciting journey, helping customers and partners in Asia and ANZ leverage NetSuite CPM and Advanced Analytics solutions atop Oracle NetSuite (TM), the numero uno cloud ERP.
Exciting times crafting solution offerings, building revenue pipelines, partner ecosystem and relationships.
So if you are using or seeking to implement Oracle NetSuite (TM) ERP and looking for a robust Financial Performance Management / Corporate Performance Management / Warehouse / Advanced Analytics solutions on high performance Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, please reach out to me. Happy to help your cause!!!

Embarked on a mission to build the EPM Analytics business for DXC REDROCK across Australia and NZ. 
Responsible for building revenue pipeline as well as building a practice from scratch
Found some very good friends as well. Enjoyed every moment of the journey.

Got the opportunity to build some really cool Financial Performance Management and Analytics solutions across many industry verticals, globally. Got the opportunity to work with the smartest people of the industry, globally. Came across my mentor and life-long guide. Made many life-long friendships. Includes my stint with Oracle Singapore as well. Thank you Oracle!!!

experiences.position: Vice President, Technology - Financial Performance Management & Business Intelligence
experiences.description:
I worked in the capacity of VP(Technology), responsible for delivering key Financial Performance Management solutions for UOB Group businesses primarily across the ASEAN region. 
The main responsibility of the job entailed 
1. Project/Program management (including responding to RFPs, evaluation of vendor proposals, managing people and vendors), 
2. Solution architecture and delivery of the solution - includes driving workshops with the key stakeholders (office of Finance), user training.

Key Financial Performance Management Solutions Delivered 
UOB Group Strategic Finance - FP&A, Strategic Planning, Financial Consolidation(UOB Group), and various financial models based on Corporate Finance best-practices.
Value Based Management Reporting for UOB Group Business.
Retail/Consumer Finance - FP&A/Profitability Analysis for Credit Cards, Consumer Loans.

experiences.position: Project Manager / Product Specialist (Financial Performance Management & Business Intelligence)
experiences.description:
I worked in the capacity of Project Manager and Financial Analytics Product Specialist based out of Standard Chartered Bank Singapore, responsible for delivering key Financial Performance Management and Reporting solutions across different businesses of Standard Chartered Bank and across various regions of operations (UK, USA, MENA, GCJ, South East Asia and South Asia)

Key responsibilities of the job entailed Solution Architecture, Advisory, Governance, Delivery of the solution, Key Stakeholder Management and Project management (including managing people and vendors) and user training.

Key Financial Performance Management Solutions Delivered 
Financial Analytics for Wholesale Banking - FP&A, Profitability Analysis, Investment and Portfolio Management, RoE & P/E Analysis
Risk Analytics for Wholesale Banking - Risk Adjusted Financial Performance Analysis which includes Risk Adjusted Profitability Analysis, Value at Risk Analysis, RoRAC and RoRWA analysis, CAR, based on Basel III.

Designed and Implemented some robust Financial Planning and Consolidation systems for the Corporate Services group of United Overseas Bank, Singapore's office of Finance. Plus got to know my mentor, which was THE biggest gain apart from the knowledge I got.

I was fortunate to be part of the pioneering team and the office of Finance who designed and implemented the Operational and Financial Planning systems for the largest mining company in the world ALCOA, across the globe - from the Americas to Australia. 
Also worked on numerous financial reporting and ERP solutions for various business of GE (TM) USA like GE Capital, GE Medical services.
Develop B2B and B2C e-commerce platforms using J2EE Beans (EJB), JSP, DHTML, ASP .NET and C#.
